zh: 放弃"处处一样"：让宇宙是球对称但不均匀的——我们恰好住在一个几十亿光年大的空洞中心。这是 Lemaître–Tolman–Bondi 解（1933/1934/1947）。它没有暗能量，却能让超新星看起来和加速膨胀的宇宙一模一样。先亲眼看它怎么骗过你，再看它怎么被戳穿。下面全部由方程实时算出。
en: Give up "the same everywhere": let the universe be spherically symmetric but inhomogeneous — we happen to live at the center of a void billions of light-years across. This is the Lemaître–Tolman–Bondi solution (1933/1934/1947). It has no dark energy, yet it can make the supernovae look exactly like an accelerating universe. First watch it fool you, then watch it get caught. Everything below is computed live from the equations.

zh: ① 你住在空洞的中心 模拟
en: ① You live at the center of a void simulated

zh: 一个剖面：点是星系，密度按今天的剖面 $\rho(r)$ 撒；颜色越暗越空。空洞里的空间膨胀得比外面快（里面物质少、减速少），所以空洞里的哈勃常数更大。
en: A cross-section: dots are galaxies, scattered according to today's density profile $\rho(r)$; the darker, the emptier. Space inside the void expands faster than outside (less matter, less deceleration), so the Hubble constant is larger inside the void.

zh: $\Omega_M(r)$ 物质份额$H_\perp(r)$ 横向膨胀率$H_\parallel(r)$ 径向膨胀率
en: $\Omega_M(r)$ matter fraction$H_\perp(r)$ transverse expansion rate$H_\parallel(r)$ radial expansion rate

zh: ② 中心观察者的哈勃图：陷阱 模拟
en: ② The central observer's Hubble diagram: the trap simulated

zh: 沿径向光线积分出红移和距离（$D_A = R(t, r)$，$D_L = (1+z)^2 D_A$），画成距离模数相对"没有空洞的 EdS"的差。再把这条曲线当成平坦 FLRW 去拟合——看看会"测"出多少暗能量。
en: Redshift and distance are integrated along radial light rays ($D_A = R(t, r)$, $D_L = (1+z)^2 D_A$) and plotted as the distance modulus relative to "EdS without a void". Then this curve is fitted as if it were a flat FLRW universe — see how much dark energy gets "measured".

zh: 这个空洞宇宙ΛCDM（Planck，真有暗能量）按 FLRW 拟合空洞得到的曲线EdS（无空洞、无 Λ）
en: this void universeΛCDM (Planck, with real dark energy)FLRW fit to the voidEdS (no void, no Λ)

zh: ③ 怎么戳穿它 模拟
en: ③ How to catch it simulated

zh: 超新星只看径向光线，分不出"真的加速"和"我们在空洞里"。能分出来的是别的观测：
en: Supernovae only look along radial rays and cannot tell "real acceleration" from "we are inside a void". Other observations can:

zh: 你偏离中心的距离 $d$
en: Your distance $d$ from the center

zh: 对数刻度，Mpc；偏离中心的观察者相对远处的 CMB 有速度，看到偶极
en: log scale, Mpc; an off-center observer moves relative to the distant CMB and sees a dipole

zh: ④ 创世参数
en: ④ Parameters of creation

zh: 今天的物质份额剖面 $\Omega_M(r)$：中心 $\Omega_{in}$、远处 $\Omega_{out}$、半径 $r_0$、过渡宽度 $\Delta r$，再加远处的哈勃常数 $H_{out}$。要求各处同时大爆炸，中心的 $H_0$ 就被定下来了。
en: Today's matter-fraction profile $\Omega_M(r)$: $\Omega_{in}$ at the center, $\Omega_{out}$ far away, radius $r_0$, transition width $\Delta r$, plus the far Hubble constant $H_{out}$. Requiring a simultaneous big bang everywhere then fixes the central $H_0$.

zh: 中心物质份额 $\Omega_{in}$
en: Central matter fraction $\Omega_{in}$

zh: 远处物质份额 $\Omega_{out}$
en: Far matter fraction $\Omega_{out}$

zh: 1 = 外面是 EdS（平坦、只有物质）
en: 1 = EdS outside (flat, matter only)

zh: 空洞半径 $r_0$
en: Void radius $r_0$

zh: 过渡宽度 $\Delta r$
en: Transition width $\Delta r$

zh: 远处的 $H_{out}$
en: Far $H_{out}$

zh: 读完你自己的发现之后再看：这个宇宙在说什么
en: Read after you have made your own discoveries: what this universe is saying

zh: 方程。球对称尘埃的精确解：$ds^2 = -dt^2 + \dfrac{R'^2}{1+2E(r)}dr^2 + R^2(t,r)\,d\Omega^2$，每一层壳 $r$ 各自满足 $\dot R^2 = \dfrac{2M(r)}{R} + 2E(r)$——就是弗里德曼方程，但质量 $M$ 和"能量" $E$ 可以一层一层不同。密度 $8\pi G\rho = 2M'/(R^2R')$。规范取今天 $R(t_0, r) = r$，并要求处处同时大爆炸（只留增长模，不然早期就不均匀得离谱）。
en: The equations. The exact solution for spherically symmetric dust: $ds^2 = -dt^2 + \dfrac{R'^2}{1+2E(r)}dr^2 + R^2(t,r)\,d\Omega^2$, where each shell $r$ separately obeys $\dot R^2 = \dfrac{2M(r)}{R} + 2E(r)$ — the Friedmann equation, but with the mass $M$ and the "energy" $E$ allowed to differ from shell to shell. The density is $8\pi G\rho = 2M'/(R^2R')$. The gauge is $R(t_0, r) = r$ today, and a simultaneous big bang is required everywhere (only the growing mode is kept; otherwise the early universe would be absurdly inhomogeneous).

zh: 为什么它能冒充暗能量。中心的观察者沿径向光线看出去，近处（空洞里）膨胀快、远处膨胀慢——这和"过去减速、现在加速"在光线上留下的印记一样：远处的超新星比按今天的 $H_0$ 外推的要暗。1998 年的超新星数据，用一个 $r_0\approx 2.5$ Gpc、中心密度只有外面 1/5 的空洞就能拟合得和 ΛCDM 一样好（García-Bellido & Haugbølle 2008 的参数就是④的第一组预设）。
en: Why it can impersonate dark energy. The central observer looks out along radial rays: nearby (inside the void) the expansion is fast, far away it is slow — and that leaves the same imprint on the light as "decelerating in the past, accelerating now": distant supernovae are fainter than an extrapolation from today's $H_0$ predicts. The 1998 supernova data can be fitted as well as by ΛCDM with a void of $r_0\approx 2.5$ Gpc whose central density is only 1/5 of the outside (the parameters of García-Bellido & Haugbølle 2008 are the first preset in ④).

zh: 怎么戳穿。(1) 它要求我们离中心不超过十几 Mpc，不然就会看到额外的 CMB 偶极——哥白尼原理被踩在脚下；(2) 远处的 $H_{out}$ 太小，CMB 和 BAO 不答应；(3) 最致命的是动力学 SZ 效应：空洞里的星系团相对 CMB 有径向速度，散射 CMB 光子留下 kSZ 信号，预言比观测大了一个数量级（Zhang & Stebbins 2011；Zibin & Moss 2011）——2011 年之后空洞模型基本出局；(4) 空洞里径向和横向膨胀率不同（①里两条线分开），BAO 的各向异性能量出来。
en: How to catch it. (1) It requires us to be within a dozen or so Mpc of the center, otherwise we would see an extra CMB dipole — the Copernican principle trampled underfoot; (2) the far $H_{out}$ is too small, and the CMB and BAO will not have it; (3) most deadly is the kinematic SZ effect: galaxy clusters inside the void move radially relative to the CMB, and scattering CMB photons leaves a kSZ signal predicted to be an order of magnitude larger than observed (Zhang & Stebbins 2011; Zibin & Moss 2011) — after 2011 the void models were essentially out; (4) inside the void the radial and transverse expansion rates differ (the two lines in ① separate), and the anisotropy can be measured with BAO.

zh: 它留下了什么。小一点的"局部空洞"（$r_0\sim 300$ Mpc、密度低 20%）今天仍被认真讨论——它能把本地测到的 $H_0$ 抬高几个百分点，是解释哈勃常数张力的候选之一（④里试试"小空洞"）。还有一个教训：反推宇宙时，"均匀各向同性"是输入进去的假设，不是观测结论；要用不同类型的观测互相钳制，才能把它反推出来。
en: What it left behind. A smaller "local void" ($r_0\sim 300$ Mpc, density 20% low) is still seriously discussed today — it can raise the locally measured $H_0$ by a few percent, one of the candidates for explaining the Hubble tension (try "Small void" in ④). And a lesson: when inferring the universe, "homogeneous and isotropic" is an assumption fed in, not an observational conclusion; only different kinds of observation pinning each other down can infer it.

zh: 标签：剖面、光线、距离、拟合全是方程算的（模拟）；偶极用的是准牛顿估计 $\Delta T/T \approx [H(d) - H_{out}]\,d/c$（近似）；kSZ 的数字引自文献，本页没有算。
en: Labels: profile, light rays, distances and fits are all computed from the equations (simulated); the dipole uses the quasi-Newtonian estimate $\Delta T/T \approx [H(d) - H_{out}]\,d/c$ (approximate); the kSZ numbers are quoted from the literature and not computed on this page.
